merc.thornwick_levyman.select.1: Pike's oiled, boots are laced. Point me at the mud.
merc.thornwick_levyman.select.2: Two groats a day, dry rations, and a stout ash shaft.
merc.thornwick_levyman.order.1: Advancing in step. Keep the shields overlapped.
merc.thornwick_levyman.order.2: Holding the line till the horn blows or the knees give.
merc.thornwick_levyman.combat.1: Plant your heels and drive iron through their ribs!
merc.thornwick_levyman.combat.2: No ground given at the ford! Push them back!
merc.thornwick_levyman.hurt.1: Gah! Just a dent in the kettle-helm, keep swinging!
merc.thornwick_levyman.hurt.2: Rib's cracked, not broken. Hold the flank!
merc.thornwick_levyman.victory.1: Road's clear. Someone scrape the bog-mud off my greaves.
merc.thornwick_levyman.victory.2: Survived another shift. That earns a double gill of ale.
merc.thornwick_levyman.idle.1: Salt Tithe took our sheep, now we bleed for copper.
merc.thornwick_levyman.idle.2: Rain always finds the collar gap before the arrow does.
merc.alder_poacher.select.1: String's waxed and dry. Who needs a quiet end?
merc.alder_poacher.select.2: Downwind and out of sight, just how I like it.
merc.alder_poacher.order.1: Moving light. Not a dry twig will snap under me.
merc.alder_poacher.order.2: Taking the high brush. Better sightlines from there.
merc.alder_poacher.combat.2: Watch the fletching drop! Another one pinned!
merc.alder_poacher.hurt.1: Tch! Clipped my bow-arm! Back off!
merc.alder_poacher.hurt.2: Blood on the bracers. That'll stain the yew.
merc.alder_poacher.victory.1: Clean shots. Now let's recover the unbroken shafts.
merc.alder_poacher.victory.2: Dead before they heard the bowstring hum.
merc.alder_poacher.idle.1: Used to hunt stags in Greywood before the tithe-men came.
merc.alder_poacher.idle.2: Fog's thickening. Keep your quivers capped.
merc.lantern_novice.select.1: Quartz lens is clean, copper rod grounded. Speak.
merc.lantern_novice.select.2: Expelled from the Collegium, still sharper than their deans.
merc.lantern_novice.order.1: Recalculating ley-arc to the new coordinates.
merc.lantern_novice.order.2: Advancing. Keep metal pikes clear of my grounding wire.
merc.lantern_novice.combat.1: Discharge! Let the pressure bleed through their mail!
merc.lantern_novice.combat.2: Focusing prism aligned! Burn the bastards out!
merc.lantern_novice.hurt.1: My ward-coil cracked! Need a second to re-ground!
merc.lantern_novice.hurt.2: Ozone in my lungs... they're inside my reach!
merc.lantern_novice.victory.1: Thermodynamic debt settled in ash and cinder.
merc.lantern_novice.victory.2: That proved the treatise. Now let's cool the rods.
merc.lantern_novice.idle.1: Smell that? Static building under the river silt.
merc.lantern_novice.idle.2: Every spell is just pressure seeking the lowest valve.
merc.quarry_sapper.select.1: Pick, wedge, and black powder. What needs cracking?
merc.quarry_sapper.select.2: Survived three cave-ins at Deep Quarry. I'm ready.
merc.quarry_sapper.order.1: Hauling the sledge forward. Clear the blast lane.
merc.quarry_sapper.order.2: Setting brace and wedge on that flank.
merc.quarry_sapper.combat.1: Crack their shields like limestone slabs!
merc.quarry_sapper.combat.2: Iron meets bone! Bring the whole wall down!
merc.quarry_sapper.hurt.1: Ugh! Feels like a quarry beam dropped on my ribs!
merc.quarry_sapper.hurt.2: Spitting dust and blood. Hit 'em harder!
merc.quarry_sapper.victory.1: Rubble and quiet. Just how a tunnel ought to look.
merc.quarry_sapper.victory.2: That seam's cleared. Check the fallen for dry powder.
merc.quarry_sapper.idle.1: Gorrathul's cisterns are dry. We dug through dust for years.
merc.quarry_sapper.idle.2: Alkali grit gets into every rivet if you don't oil it.
merc.cistern_acolyte.select.1: Water ration's measured, bandages boiled. Lead on.
merc.cistern_acolyte.select.2: I know every cistern-pipe and fever-herb in Redmarsh.
merc.cistern_acolyte.order.1: Moving to support the line. Keep your canteens sealed.
merc.cistern_acolyte.combat.1: Hold your breath! Don't let the alkali dust settle!
merc.cistern_acolyte.combat.2: Strike clean! I'll stitch whoever stays standing!
merc.cistern_acolyte.hurt.1: They're aiming for the medics! Shield me!
merc.cistern_acolyte.hurt.2: My satchel's torn! Press the wound and hold!
merc.cistern_acolyte.victory.1: No one bleeds out on my watch. Form up for dressing.
merc.cistern_acolyte.victory.2: Still breathing. Drink half a gill, no more.
merc.cistern_acolyte.idle.1: Boiled rainwater at dawn, vinegar-brine at dusk.
merc.cistern_acolyte.idle.2: The Wardstones hum louder when a dust-squall rolls in.
merc.tomb_notary.select.1: Gall-ink is wet, copper wire coiled. Name the debtor.
merc.tomb_notary.select.2: Probate Debt Law binds flesh and bone alike.
merc.tomb_notary.order.1: Proceeding to audit the next sector.
merc.tomb_notary.combat.1: Your arrears are due in marrow and sinew!
merc.tomb_notary.combat.2: Seal their joints! Let the cold writ take hold!
merc.tomb_notary.hurt.1: Assaulting an officer of the Scriptorium! Unlawful!
merc.tomb_notary.hurt.2: My ink-horn shattered! Curse these savages!
merc.tomb_notary.victory.1: Ledger balanced. Enter the casualties under settled.
merc.tomb_notary.victory.2: Death does not void a granary lien. Remember that.
merc.tomb_notary.idle.1: Three copper coils around the ribs, two under the jaw.
merc.tomb_notary.idle.2: Every bone in Redmarsh owes interest to someone.
merc.oakhaven_marine.select.1: Cutlass honed, tarred coat buttoned. Ready to board.
merc.oakhaven_marine.select.2: Fought on wet decks in gale force. Mud won't stop me.
merc.oakhaven_marine.order.1: Double-time to the gangplank! Move it!
merc.oakhaven_marine.order.2: Forming boarding wedge on your mark.
merc.oakhaven_marine.combat.1: Grapple and gut 'em! Give no quarter on the pier!
merc.oakhaven_marine.combat.2: Sweep the deck! Send 'em to the harbor silt!
merc.oakhaven_marine.hurt.1: Salt in the cut! Keep pressing, don't stall!
merc.oakhaven_marine.hurt.2: Took a heavy clout! Watch my blind side!
merc.oakhaven_marine.victory.1: Deck's ours. Toss the scrap over the seawall.
merc.oakhaven_marine.victory.2: Nothing left standing. Sound the all-clear.
merc.oakhaven_marine.idle.1: Whale-oil smoke hangs over the drydocks all week now.
merc.oakhaven_marine.idle.2: Better to drown clean than burn on Vesperion's hulks.
merc.harbor_arbalest.select.1: Windlass cranked, steel prod locked. Pick a breastplate.
merc.harbor_arbalest.select.2: Heavy bolts punch through oak and plate alike.
merc.harbor_arbalest.order.1: Shifting firing lane. Keep heads down.
merc.harbor_arbalest.order.2: Bracing on the parapet. Ready on your word.
merc.harbor_arbalest.combat.1: Crack their cuirass! Loosing heavy steel!
merc.harbor_arbalest.combat.2: Reloading! Cover me for three heartbeats!
merc.harbor_arbalest.hurt.1: Bolt took my shoulder! Can't crank fast like this!
merc.harbor_arbalest.hurt.2: They closed the distance! Draw sidearms!
merc.harbor_arbalest.victory.1: Punched clean through their shields. Good iron.
merc.harbor_arbalest.victory.2: Target down. Winding the goat's-foot back up.
merc.harbor_arbalest.idle.1: Sea-fog rusts a steel prod if you skip the tallow.
merc.harbor_arbalest.idle.2: Counted four Black Fleet lanterns off the breakwater.
merc.storm_channeler.select.1: Smoked quartz lenses set. Tell me where the storm goes.
merc.storm_channeler.select.2: The sea-air carries enough charge to blister bronze.
merc.storm_channeler.order.1: Relocating the brass rod. Mind the trailing wire.
merc.storm_channeler.combat.1: Call the gale down! Snap their masts and spines!
merc.storm_channeler.combat.2: Arc-discharge! Watch the wet iron glow!
merc.storm_channeler.hurt.1: Feedback spike! My gauntlets are smoking!
merc.storm_channeler.victory.1: Storm's spent. Air tastes like copper and salt.
merc.storm_channeler.idle.1: The Conclave measured the tide-current before the blockade.
merc.storm_channeler.idle.2: Hair's standing up. Either squall's coming or a ward broke.
merc.ironcamp_halberdier.select.1: Star-iron edge, caldera-quenched. Give the order.
merc.ironcamp_halberdier.select.2: We hold the basalt road or we burn on it.
merc.ironcamp_halberdier.order.1: Advancing through the ash. Keep goggles tight.
merc.ironcamp_halberdier.combat.1: Hook their shields and bring the axe-head down!
merc.ironcamp_halberdier.combat.2: For Ironcamp! Cleave through the cinder-guard!
merc.ironcamp_halberdier.hurt.1: Armor's glowing hot! Need water or space!
merc.ironcamp_halberdier.hurt.2: Just ash and blood. Still got two hands on the haft!
merc.ironcamp_halberdier.victory.1: Basalt's slick with soot. Catch your breath.
merc.ironcamp_halberdier.victory.2: No demon-forged brute breaks our pike-line.
merc.ironcamp_halberdier.idle.1: Four heartbeats in sulfur brine. That's how Vok tempers it.
merc.ironcamp_halberdier.idle.2: Caldera ash clogs the lung-cloths every hour.
merc.ash_battlemage.select.1: Vok's runes are cold-stamped and primed. Speak.
merc.ash_battlemage.select.2: Steel in one hand, caldera pressure in the other.
merc.ash_battlemage.order.1: Stepping into the draft. Keep blades ready.
merc.ash_battlemage.combat.1: Bleed the furnace! Melt their plate to slag!
merc.ash_battlemage.combat.2: Runes flaring! Strike while they're blinded!
merc.ash_battlemage.hurt.1: My leather apron's charring! Fall back a pace!
merc.ash_battlemage.victory.1: Vitrified 'em clean. Good quench, good kill.
merc.ash_battlemage.victory.2: Forge-heat wins where cold iron bends.
merc.ash_battlemage.idle.1: Every Anchor Seal down there groans like an anvil.
merc.ash_battlemage.idle.2: Don't touch raw star-iron bare-handed near a vent.
merc.penitent_flagellant.select.1: The iron collar weighs less than cowardice. Lead on.
merc.penitent_flagellant.select.2: Ash cleanses what tallow and coin corrupt.
merc.penitent_flagellant.order.1: Marching into the fire without flinching.
merc.penitent_flagellant.combat.1: Strike me if you dare! The flame answers back!
merc.penitent_flagellant.combat.2: Bear the penance! Break their wicked ranks!
merc.penitent_flagellant.hurt.1: Pain is only the furnace testing the slag!
merc.penitent_flagellant.hurt.2: More blood! Let the Anchor Seals drink!
merc.penitent_flagellant.victory.1: The trial ends. Our vow remains unbroken.
merc.penitent_flagellant.victory.2: Ashes to ashes. Walk on, brothers.
merc.penitent_flagellant.idle.1: Four hundred years the Seven Valves bled the mountain.
merc.penitent_flagellant.idle.2: Sightless eyes still feel the heat of the Dais.
npc.hobb_smith.greet.1: Bellows are hot and the river-coal's dry. What's bent?
npc.hobb_smith.greet.2: Bring me bog-iron, not clipped groats, and I'll forge true.
npc.hobb_smith.trade.1: Every rivet checked twice before it leaves my anvil.
npc.hobb_smith.rumor.1: Morvessa's men burned the Mint to hide shaved silver.
npc.hobb_smith.farewell.1: Keep your edge oiled against the alder mist.
npc.hobb_smith.farewell.2: Don't let a gnoll catch you with a notched shield.
npc.marta_alchemist.greet.1: Mind the glass flasks. Peat-vitriol stains worse than blood.
npc.marta_alchemist.greet.2: Need poultice, lamp-tallow, or something sharper for gnolls?
npc.marta_alchemist.trade.1: Boiled willow-bark and clean lard. No watered-down junk.
npc.marta_alchemist.rumor.1: Folks hear silk scraping under Ravenwatch's floorstones.
npc.marta_alchemist.farewell.1: Wash your cuts with brine before sunset.
npc.marta_alchemist.farewell.2: Come back in one piece, Commander.
npc.garrick_captain.greet.1: Watch rotation's thin. Good to see real steel in Thornwick.
npc.garrick_captain.greet.2: Keep your boots out of the mud and your eyes on the treeline.
npc.garrick_captain.trade.1: Quartermaster stock's rationed, but you've earned first pick.
npc.garrick_captain.rumor.1: Grok'tar's warband carries fresh-stamped Border Mint copper.
npc.garrick_captain.farewell.1: Hold Sunken Ford, and we hold the whole valley.
npc.garrick_captain.farewell.2: Sound the horn if you spot torches on the ridge.
npc.fenwick_ferryman.greet.1: Alder's running high and cold. Watch the submerged pilings.
npc.fenwick_ferryman.greet.2: Ferry's moored tight till the bridge pickets clear the bank.
npc.fenwick_ferryman.trade.1: Got tarred rope and dry peat if your kit's soaked.
npc.fenwick_ferryman.rumor.1: Saw silk-wrapped crates floated downstream at midnight.
npc.fenwick_ferryman.farewell.1: Mind the ford stones; moss makes 'em slick as tallow.
npc.fenwick_ferryman.farewell.2: May the river carry your foes under, not you.
npc.bram_quartermaster.greet.1: Sign the tally-slate first. Nothing leaves Redmarsh unweighed.
npc.bram_quartermaster.greet.2: Water, salt, ironstone: every ounce is accounted for.
npc.bram_quartermaster.trade.1: Caravan rates apply. No credit for dead men.
npc.bram_quartermaster.rumor.1: Ironheart's cisterns haven't sent down a drop in three years.
npc.bram_quartermaster.farewell.1: Keep your canteen capped in the alkali wind.
npc.bram_quartermaster.farewell.2: Bring back whole axles if you raid the quarry.
npc.zahra_scholar.greet.1: The quartz wardstones are weeping static. Look at my lenses.
npc.zahra_scholar.greet.2: Someone chiseled reverse blood-wards into the primeval plinths.
npc.zahra_scholar.trade.1: I trade ward-charts and copper wire, not tavern gossip.
npc.zahra_scholar.rumor.1: Third-Dynasty vaults beneath the quarry still hold live liens.
npc.zahra_scholar.farewell.1: Ground your rods before the dust-squall peaks.
npc.zahra_scholar.farewell.2: Send word if you find an intact ward-tablet.
npc.tull_water_seller.greet.1: Half a pint boiled rainwater, weighed on apothecary brass!
npc.tull_water_seller.greet.2: Thirsty? Pay in silver or salt-scrips, no bent copper.
npc.tull_water_seller.trade.1: Cleanest gill west of the Bastion, sealed in pitch.
npc.tull_water_seller.rumor.1: Gorrathul locks the sluices to hide an empty aquifer.
npc.tull_water_seller.farewell.1: Drink slow or the sun'll split your head.
npc.tull_water_seller.farewell.2: Save a drop for the return march.
npc.sera_healer.greet.1: Step into the lantern light. Let's see what the sea-wall took.
npc.sera_healer.greet.2: Whale-oil burns are nasty. Sit still while I scrape the soot.
npc.sera_healer.trade.1: Clean linen, vinegar wash, and bone-splints ready.
npc.sera_healer.rumor.1: Vesperion's drowned choir sings right before a fire-hulk hits.
npc.sera_healer.farewell.1: Don't wade in canal bilge with open blisters.
npc.sera_healer.farewell.2: Live to board those carracks, Commander.
npc.kors_shipwright.greet.1: Hull timbers are charred, but the keel's still oak-sound.
npc.kors_shipwright.greet.2: Need a bronze culverin trunnion or a patched breastplate?
npc.kors_shipwright.trade.1: Shipyard iron costs double in a blockade, no haggling.
npc.kors_shipwright.rumor.1: Two carracks in drydock just need copper sheathing and pitch.
npc.kors_shipwright.farewell.1: Keep the sea-gates shut till the tide turns.
npc.kors_shipwright.farewell.2: Give Vesperion a broadside from me.
npc.lyra_warden.greet.1: Bailey Truce holds while your company holds the outer gate.
npc.lyra_warden.greet.2: Check your powder-horns. Sea-damp ruins a match in minutes.
npc.lyra_warden.trade.1: Guild munitions go to troops who actually push the quay.
npc.lyra_warden.rumor.1: Greywash canal locks can still flood the Sunken Citadel.
npc.lyra_warden.farewell.1: Watch the breakwater for fire-hulks at dusk.
npc.pip_mudlark.greet.1: Found copper rivets and a soggy boot by the pilings! Interested?
npc.pip_mudlark.greet.2: Low tide leaves all sorts of shiny things in the silt.
npc.pip_mudlark.trade.1: Cheap salvage! Only slightly chewed by salt-crabs!
npc.pip_mudlark.rumor.1: Saw black-cloaked sailors dumping chains near the lighthouse.
npc.pip_mudlark.farewell.1: Don't step in the deep mud, guv!
npc.pip_mudlark.farewell.2: I'll save the best trinkets for you!
npc.rowan_commander.greet.1: You made the crossing. Half our carracks never touched ash.
npc.rowan_commander.greet.2: Strap on your goggles. Basalt dust cuts like ground glass.
npc.rowan_commander.trade.1: Take what's left in the siege-chest. We won't need it dead.
npc.rowan_commander.rumor.1: Malrik's blind acolytes are setting prisms on the Ashveil stairs.
npc.rowan_commander.farewell.1: See you at the Crossroads of Headless Kings.
npc.rowan_commander.farewell.2: Don't let the caldera heat cook your wits.
npc.vok_forgemaster.greet.1: Star-iron screams if you quench it a heartbeat too late!
npc.vok_forgemaster.greet.2: Smoked goggles on, leather apron wet. Step to the hearth.
npc.vok_forgemaster.trade.1: Caldera-tempered steel. Nothing finer south of the sea.
npc.vok_forgemaster.rumor.1: The seventh Anchor Seal is groaning under too much pressure.
npc.vok_forgemaster.farewell.1: Swing true. My hammer-marks don't forgive cowardice.
npc.vok_forgemaster.farewell.2: Bring me star-iron shards if you crack a warden.
npc.elias_penitent.greet.1: I gave my eyes to hear the mountain breathe. Speak softly.
npc.elias_penitent.greet.2: The iron collar reminds us what unbridled fire costs.
npc.elias_penitent.trade.1: Penitents keep little, only ash-salve and cold wards.
npc.elias_penitent.rumor.1: Ashkarath guards the valves not from malice, but dread.
npc.elias_penitent.farewell.1: Choose wisely when you reach the Obsidian Dais.
npc.elias_penitent.farewell.2: May cold ash steady your heart.
npc.warden_hale.greet.1: Thornwick stands on grit and short rations. Glad you're here.
npc.warden_hale.greet.2: The Border Guard bleeds, yet we haven't yielded Alder Bridge.
npc.warden_hale.trade.1: Take whatever border stores remain in the garrison chest.
npc.warden_hale.rumor.1: Morvessa's silk-brood nests deep beneath Ravenwatch Keep.
npc.warden_hale.farewell.1: Rally the ford, Commander. The refugees count on us.
npc.warden_hale.farewell.2: Keep your company tight in the Greywood mist.
npc.reeve_marlow.greet.1: Tax-rolls are ashes, yet the Salt Tithe demands double.
npc.reeve_marlow.greet.2: Every granary in the parish has been scraped to the planks.
npc.reeve_marlow.trade.1: Parish coin is light, so we trade in iron and salt.
npc.reeve_marlow.rumor.1: Clipped groats from the burned Mint turned up in gnoll camps.
npc.reeve_marlow.farewell.1: Bring back the Assay Ledger if it still exists.
npc.reeve_marlow.farewell.2: May honest weight return to Thornwick.
npc.orlen_gravetender.greet.1: Keep your lantern low. Cold tallow burns longer in the crypts.
npc.orlen_gravetender.greet.2: Too many fresh mounds this winter, and the earth won't thaw.
npc.orlen_gravetender.trade.1: Spades, salt-ash, and grave-iron, all a watcher needs.
npc.orlen_gravetender.rumor.1: Something beneath the Ossuary is weaving bone with pale silk.
npc.orlen_gravetender.farewell.1: Seal any tomb-door you open behind you.
npc.orlen_gravetender.farewell.2: Let the dead keep their quiet, if they can.
npc.sabik_sandwalker.greet.1: Dunes shift overnight, but the quartz monoliths never lie.
npc.sabik_sandwalker.greet.2: Follow the calcified ribcages if the dust blots the sun.
npc.sabik_sandwalker.trade.1: Got veil-cloth, alkali salve, and sound pack-straps.
npc.sabik_sandwalker.rumor.1: Ashen Coven chanters camp beside the fractured north stone.
npc.sabik_sandwalker.farewell.1: Walk light on the crust; sinkholes swallow horses whole.
npc.sabik_sandwalker.farewell.2: See you at the Ironheart causeway.
npc.harbor_master_tavin.greet.1: Boom-chains are raised and the beacon's low on whale-oil.
npc.harbor_master_tavin.greet.2: No hull clears Oakhaven without my seal on the manifest.
npc.harbor_master_tavin.trade.1: Port tariffs are waived for anyone sinking Black Fleet ships.
npc.harbor_master_tavin.rumor.1: Vesperion's flagship sits just beyond the outer lighthouse.
npc.harbor_master_tavin.farewell.1: Clear the harbor mouth and you'll have your fleet.
npc.sage_quillon.greet.1: Every spell is pressure and copper, never prayer.
npc.sage_quillon.greet.2: The Conclave's prisms are cracked, yet our math holds true.
npc.sage_quillon.trade.1: Smoked lenses and grounding coils, calibrated by hand.
npc.sage_quillon.rumor.1: Rupturing the seventh Anchor Seal would turn the air to flame.
npc.sage_quillon.farewell.1: Measure twice before you channel a full ley-surge.
npc.sage_quillon.farewell.2: May your wards hold against the southern heat.
